negative_reference: UniProtKB:Q95554 is cited only to reject an unrelated mouse-protein cross-reference; it is not a participant.

unresolved_identity_decisions.decision: Reject reciprocal link; do not transfer Q59994 into native CPLX-142. Independent Q59994 inferred activity is retained.
TKTASYN-MONOMER supplies both native activities; P73282 only supplies its separately scoped automated activity and cofactors. No equality or distinct-isozyme assertion.

Native tetramer convention is explicit; 3RPL engineered tag plus P73922 residues2–345 bridge is distinct from full native chain. Dimer/inactive tetramer/active tetramer depend on ligands; paper states346 residues, deposited engineered sequence379, current native345.

Web-inspected PMID9602137 abstract reports 388-aa ORF D89973, whereas current P73922 is 345 aa. Exact historical sequence bridge is unproved; no 1998-to-current equivalence is used. Its cited PMID8837735 concerns Synechococcus PCC7942, not Synechocystis PCC6803.
3RPL entity1 provides the stated canonical engineered core bridge; entity2 has CSO modifications and is not treated as a chemically identical unmodified native chain.
Current/native Zn annotation retained with similarity/database tier; inspected primary uses cobalt and cannot prove physiological Zn.
